# Benchmark results — SYNTHETIC DATA (not IEEE-CIS)

Run at: 2026-11-25T01:00:08+00:00

**SYNTHETIC dataset** generated by `simulate_frame()` in this script: 120,000 rows shaped like `load_ieee_cis` output (25 numeric features, ProductCD + card4 categoricals), ~3.5% true fraud, 3% of labels flipped at random (injected label noise; observed prevalence ~6.3%), fraud pattern drifts halfway through the ~180-day timeline. These numbers say something about SentinelBoost's design goals on data built to stress them; they are NOT IEEE-CIS results and prove nothing about real-world performance.

| Model | ROC-AUC | PR-AUC | Bucket ROC-AUC mean | Bucket ROC-AUC std | Per-bucket ROC-AUC |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| XGBoost champion (ieee_cis.build_pipeline) | 0.6083 | 0.0965 | 0.6080 | 0.0137 | 0.606, 0.587, 0.623, 0.616 |
| SentinelBoost (full) | 0.6052 | 0.0866 | 0.6047 | 0.0150 | 0.608, 0.588, 0.628, 0.595 |
| SentinelBoost (all mechanisms OFF = plain LightGBM) | 0.6183 | 0.1009 | 0.6179 | 0.0194 | 0.611, 0.593, 0.647, 0.621 |

Stability = ROC-AUC computed separately on 4 consecutive time buckets of the chronological test set; lower std = more stable performance over time.
## Findings (ablation diagnosis, same simulated data)

| Configuration | ROC-AUC | PR-AUC | Bucket std |
|---|---|---|---|
| Plain LightGBM (all off) | 0.6183 | 0.1009 | 0.0194 |
| Noise filter only | 0.6219 | 0.1006 | 0.0115 |
| Interactions only | 0.6143 | 0.1012 | 0.0155 |
| Recency only | 0.6359 | 0.1377 | 0.0188 |
| Calibration only | 0.5844 | 0.0782 | 0.0181 |
| Full minus calibration | 0.6352 | 0.1308 | 0.0201 |

Recency weighting is the clear win under drift; the noise filter helps
modestly (downweighted ~2.5% of training samples, best stability);
interactions are neutral. The full model trails because the
time-ordered calibration holdout removes the newest 15% of training
data (12,600 rows — the most post-drift data), which costs more AUC
than the other mechanisms gain. The isotonic mapping itself is
rank-preserving; the cost is the holdout design under drift. See
experiments/README.md for the full discussion. Note: test labels carry
the same 3% flip noise, compressing all AUCs toward ~0.6.
